rewritten_description:
Sandal Powder Herbal 100g Face Pack is a traditional Ayurvedic blend of natural ingredients. This face pack is designed to help maintain healthy, balanced skin. The powder can be mixed with water to create a paste, which can then be applied to the skin. It is recommended to use this face pack three times a week for optimal results. To use, take the required quantity of powder, add a little water, and gently massage onto the skin with rotating finger tips. Leave on for 30 to 45 minutes before washing thoroughly with water. Our Sandal Powder Herbal Face Pack is made from pure, natural ingredients and is free from perfumes and chemicals.
